_notes: Real scope-out data captured 2026-07-26 by dejarjar013, sourced from 'TEST SHEET - KCH Targets - dejarjar013.csv'. Not synthetic — use this to avoid hand re-entering all 33 secondary items during dev/QA.
secondaryLoot is keyed by itemId (see data/secondary-loot.json for names/floors/weights) and holds the actual scoped dollar amount for this run.
Items omitted from secondaryLoot were not scoped this run (blank in the source sheet) — e.g. B-A (Swingset Study No. LXIX).

BAY (Delivery Truck Crate) is a checkbox in-game, not a typed dollar value — its true value can't be known until you actually take it during the heist. Checked here, so its value is the fixed community estimate of $122,500 (average of the known $105k/$140k range). Page 1 should render BAY as a checkbox, not a number input, per internal/requirements.md.
hardMode affects primaryTarget.value and the Buyer's Request/Elite bonuses only — it does NOT modify secondaryLoot values, which are already the actual randomized amounts observed in-game.
primaryTarget.value = baseValue 365000 * hard multiplier 1.10 = 401500 (firstTimeThisWeek is false for this run, confirmed by user, so no 4.00x applied).
buyersChoice lists the 3 items marked 'Mandatory?' in the source sheet.

testPlayerCounts intentionally excludes 1: buyersChoice includes 2-H (Gemstone), a Crisp Gallery item with minPlayers: 2 in data/secondary-loot.json, and eliteChallengeAttempted is true (which makes Buyer's Choice mandatory to pack) — a 1-player crew cannot legally run this exact scope. See internal/requirements.md Sentry testing notes for what to verify instead at player count 1.
